slider.label: Atmosphere Height (m)
slider.name: sky_max_y
slider.tool_tip: Height of the atmosphere: limits fog, haze and sun dimming.

slider.label: Atmosphere Thickness
slider.name: sky_density_multiplier
slider.tool_tip: Scales haze thickness and sun extinction.

slider.label: Fog Distance Scale
slider.name: sky_distance_multiplier
slider.tool_tip: Scales how fast distance fog builds.

slider.label: Haze Density
slider.name: sky_haze_density
slider.tool_tip: At 0, Haze Glow Strength, Haze Glow Focus and Haze Glow Brightness stop working, fog takes Air Glow Color only, and distance fog depends on Air Density's red channel. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Haze Glow Brightness
slider.name: sky_haze_horizon
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of white haze and its sun glow. No effect while Haze Density is 0. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Haze Glow Strength
slider.name: sky_glow_strength
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the haze glow around the sun; higher = brighter. Does not change its spread. No effect while Haze Density is 0. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Haze Glow Focus
slider.name: sky_glow_focus
slider.tool_tip: Tightness of the haze glow; higher = tighter halo. No effect while Haze Density is 0. (KS Reference)

text.name: skyc_blue_horizon_label
text.tool_tip: Sky and distant-fog color from clear air. Sole fog color while Haze Density is 0.

color_swatch.name: skyc_blue_horizon
color_swatch.tool_tip: Sky and distant-fog color from clear air. Sole fog color while Haze Density is 0.

text.name: skyc_blue_density_label
text.tool_tip: Clear-air amount per color: sunset reddening, fog fade rate and the air/haze mix. Fog strength follows the red component while Haze Density is 0.

color_swatch.name: skyc_blue_density
color_swatch.tool_tip: Clear-air amount per color: sunset reddening, fog fade rate and the air/haze mix. Fog strength follows the red component while Haze Density is 0.
